validated_basis: CSIR-NBRI & MSME/KVIC: 1 kg dry floral powder (55-60% of mix) + jiggit (15-20%) + charcoal/wood filler (15-25%) minus 6% rolling/drying loss = ~1.55 kg finished incense (~1,000+ sticks).

ICAR / NCOF co-composting: raw floral waste mixed 60:40 with cow dung/bulking material loses moisture & volatile carbon during thermophilic decomposition, yielding ~44% cured compost relative to usable fresh waste mass.

ICAR / NCOF Eisenia fetida trials: 60:40 floral-to-cow-dung mix achieves 51-65% mixed-feed bioconversion; relative to usable flower input alone after moisture balance & screening, net screened vermicompost yield is ~52% (0.52 kg per kg usable waste).

CSIR-NBRI Herbal Gulal: extracted floral pigment/powder (~32-35% of mix) blended with natural arrowroot/cornstarch carrier (~65-68% of mix) minus 8% sieving loss = ~2.58 kg herbal gulal per kg dry floral powder.
Dried petals combined with natural wax/paper pulp/potpourri fixatives minus 10% craft trimming loss = ~1.67 kg finished decor per kg dry floral powder.
